title: Verse Recall evaluation case
description: Schema for each non-comment line in a verse-recall JSONL corpus.

prompt.description: The user query exactly as submitted to search.

category.description: Primary failure-mode category, such as event-name, paraphrase, or translation-drift.

gold_refs.description: Accepted verse, chapter, or passage ranges. Empty means the query is not scripture.

gold_mode.description: Whether any accepted gold is sufficient or every independently remembered gold must be retrieved.

must_not.description: Hard-negative passages that must rank below the completed gold target.

expected_confidence.description: Optional required UX confidence label on the relevant result.

expected_passages.description: Optional structured passage ranges; every listed range must be covered by top-three structured output.

family.description: Stable semantic/passage family. Every case in a family must use the same split.

split.description: Dataset partition, for example dev, regression, or holdout-v1.

tags.description: Secondary query forms, translations, and provenance labels.

source.description: Human-readable source for the query form.
